∀ {F Idx : Type u} (a b : Minidregg.Compiler.Term (Minidregg.Compiler.AirSig F Idx)) (n : ℕ), Minidregg.Compiler.flatten (Minidregg.Compiler.add' a b) n = have l := Minidregg.Compiler.flatten a n; have r := Minidregg.Compiler.flatten b l.next; { out := Minidregg.Compiler.WireRef.aux r.next, gates := l.gates ++ r.gates ++ [{ op := Minidregg.Compiler.GateOp.add, a := l.out, b := r.out, out := r.next }], next := r.next + 1 }

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} (asg : Idx → F) (t : Minidregg.Compiler.Term (Minidregg.Compiler.AirSig F Idx)) (n₀ : ℕ) {auxv auxv' : ℕ → F}, Minidregg.Compiler.gatesHold asg auxv (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).gates → Minidregg.Compiler.gatesHold asg auxv' (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).gates → ∀ (m : ℕ), n₀ ≤ m → m < (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).next → auxv m = auxv' m

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} (asg : Idx → F) (t : Minidregg.Compiler.Term (Minidregg.Compiler.AirSig F Idx)) (n₀ : ℕ), (∃ auxv, Minidregg.Compiler.gatesHold asg auxv (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).gates ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.WireRef.read asg auxv (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).out = 0) ↔ Minidregg.Compiler.accepts asg t

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} (asg : Idx → F) (t : Minidregg.Compiler.Term (Minidregg.Compiler.AirSig F Idx)) (n₀ : ℕ), (∃ auxv, Minidregg.Compiler.gatesHold asg auxv (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).gates ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.WireRef.read asg auxv (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).out = 0) ↔ Minidregg.Compiler.semHolds asg t

∀ {F Idx : Type u} (t : Minidregg.Compiler.Term (Minidregg.Compiler.AirSig F Idx)) (n₀ m : ℕ), n₀ ≤ m → m < (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).next → ∃ g ∈ (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).gates, g.out = m
∀ {F Idx : Type u} (c : F) (n : ℕ), Minidregg.Compiler.flatten (Minidregg.Compiler.cst c) n = { out := Minidregg.Compiler.WireRef.cnst c, gates := [], next := n }

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} (asg : Idx → F) (t : Minidregg.Compiler.Term (Minidregg.Compiler.AirSig F Idx)) (n₀ : ℕ) (auxv : ℕ → F), Minidregg.Compiler.gatesHold asg auxv (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).gates → Minidregg.Compiler.WireRef.read asg auxv (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).out = Minidregg.Compiler.eval asg t

∀ {F Idx : Type u} (k : Bool → Minidregg.Compiler.Term (Minidregg.Compiler.AirSig F Idx)) (n : ℕ), Minidregg.Compiler.flatten (WType.mk Minidregg.Compiler.AirOp.add k) n = have l := Minidregg.Compiler.flatten (k Bool.false) n; have r := Minidregg.Compiler.flatten (k Bool.true) l.next; { out := Minidregg.Compiler.WireRef.aux r.next, gates := l.gates ++ r.gates ++ [{ op := Minidregg.Compiler.GateOp.add, a := l.out, b := r.out, out := r.next }], next := r.next + 1 }

∀ {F Idx : Type u} (k : Bool → Minidregg.Compiler.Term (Minidregg.Compiler.AirSig F Idx)) (n : ℕ), Minidregg.Compiler.flatten (WType.mk Minidregg.Compiler.AirOp.mul k) n = have l := Minidregg.Compiler.flatten (k Bool.false) n; have r := Minidregg.Compiler.flatten (k Bool.true) l.next; { out := Minidregg.Compiler.WireRef.aux r.next, gates := l.gates ++ r.gates ++ [{ op := Minidregg.Compiler.GateOp.mul, a := l.out, b := r.out, out := r.next }], next := r.next + 1 }

∀ {F Idx : Type u} (a b : Minidregg.Compiler.Term (Minidregg.Compiler.AirSig F Idx)) (n : ℕ), Minidregg.Compiler.flatten (Minidregg.Compiler.mul' a b) n = have l := Minidregg.Compiler.flatten a n; have r := Minidregg.Compiler.flatten b l.next; { out := Minidregg.Compiler.WireRef.aux r.next, gates := l.gates ++ r.gates ++ [{ op := Minidregg.Compiler.GateOp.mul, a := l.out, b := r.out, out := r.next }], next := r.next + 1 }

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} (asg : Idx → F) (t : Minidregg.Compiler.Term (Minidregg.Compiler.AirSig F Idx)) (n₀ : ℕ) {auxv auxv' : ℕ → F}, Minidregg.Compiler.gatesHold asg auxv (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).gates → Minidregg.Compiler.gatesHold asg auxv' (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).gates → Minidregg.Compiler.WireRef.read asg auxv (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).out = Minidregg.Compiler.WireRef.read asg auxv' (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).out

∀ {F Idx : Type u} (t : Minidregg.Compiler.Term (Minidregg.Compiler.AirSig F Idx)) (n₀ : ℕ), n₀ ≤ (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).next ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.WireRef.auxIn n₀ (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).next (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).out ∧ ∀ g ∈ (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).gates, Minidregg.Compiler.Gate.scopedIn n₀ (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).next g

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} (asg : Idx → F) (t : Minidregg.Compiler.Term (Minidregg.Compiler.AirSig F Idx)) (n₀ : ℕ), ∃ auxv, Minidregg.Compiler.gatesHold asg auxv (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).gates ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.WireRef.read asg auxv (Minidregg.Compiler.flatten t n₀).out = Minidregg.Compiler.eval asg t
∀ {F Idx : Type u} (i : Idx) (n : ℕ), Minidregg.Compiler.flatten (Minidregg.Compiler.vr i) n = { out := Minidregg.Compiler.WireRef.var i, gates := [], next := n }

{F : Type u} → [Field F] → {Idx : Type u} → (Idx → F) → (ℕ → F) → List (Minidregg.Compiler.Gate F Idx) → Prop := fun {F} [Field F] {Idx} asg auxv gs => ∀ g ∈ gs, Minidregg.Compiler.Gate.holds asg auxv g
